name: hugo-narrow
description: A modern, clean Hugo theme built with Tailwind CSS 4.

scripts.dev: pnpm run compile && pnpm run hugo:dev
scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run build
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:templates:check && pnpm run format:js:check
scripts.format:write: pnpm run format:templates && pnpm run format:js
scripts.format:templates:check: files=$(gotmplfmt -l layouts) || exit 1; if [ -n "$files" ]; then echo "$files"; exit 1; fi
